1 Chronicles 21:1.k: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
1 Chronicles 21:1.w: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

1 Corinthians 10:16.b: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
1 Corinthians 10:16.k: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
1 Corinthians 10:16.w: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.b: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.k: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.w: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.b: Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.k: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.w: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.b: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot partake in the table of the Lord and the table of demons too.
1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.k: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.
1 Corinthians 10:16, 17,21.w: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

1 Corinthians 11:13, 14.b: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
1 Corinthians 11:13, 14.k: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
1 Corinthians 11:13, 14.w: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

1 Corinthians 11:13, 14.b: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
1 Corinthians 11:13, 14.k: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
1 Corinthians 11:13, 14.w: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

1 Corinthians 11:23-26.k: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
1 Corinthians 11:23-26.w: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

1 Corinthians 11:23-26.b: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
1 Corinthians 11:23-26.k: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
1 Corinthians 11:23-26.w: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

1 Corinthians 11:23-26.b: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”
1 Corinthians 11:23-26.k: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
1 Corinthians 11:23-26.w: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

1 Corinthians 11:23-26.b: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
1 Corinthians 11:23-26.k: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
1 Corinthians 11:23-26.w: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

1 Corinthians 11:24, 25.k: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

1 Corinthians 11:26-28.k: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
1 Corinthians 11:26-28.w: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

1 Corinthians 11:26-28.b: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
1 Corinthians 11:26-28.k: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
1 Corinthians 11:26-28.w: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

1 Corinthians 11:26-28.b: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.
1 Corinthians 11:26-28.k: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
1 Corinthians 11:26-28.w: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

1 Corinthians 11:27.b: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
1 Corinthians 11:27.k: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
1 Corinthians 11:27.w: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

1 Corinthians 11:29.b: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.
1 Corinthians 11:29.k: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
1 Corinthians 11:29.w: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

1 Corinthians 11:32.b: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
1 Corinthians 11:32.k: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
1 Corinthians 11:32.w: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: For the body is not one member, but many.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: For the body is not one member, but many.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: But now they are many members, but one body.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

1 Corinthians 12:14-27.b: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a member of it.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.k: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
1 Corinthians 12:14-27.w: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

1 Corinthians 12:7.b: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.
1 Corinthians 12:7.k: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
1 Corinthians 12:7.w: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

1 Corinthians 13:1.b: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
1 Corinthians 13:1.k: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
1 Corinthians 13:1.w: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

1 Corinthians 14:16, 17.b: Otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
1 Corinthians 14:16, 17.k: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
1 Corinthians 14:16, 17.w: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

1 Corinthians 14:16, 17.b: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.
1 Corinthians 14:16, 17.k: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
1 Corinthians 14:16, 17.w: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

1 Corinthians 14:26,40.b: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
1 Corinthians 14:26,40.k: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
1 Corinthians 14:26,40.w: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

1 Corinthians 14:26,40.b: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.
1 Corinthians 14:26,40.k: Let all things be done decently and in order.
1 Corinthians 14:26,40.w: Let all things be done decently and in order.

1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.b: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.k: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.w: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.b: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.k: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.w: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.b: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.k: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.w: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.b: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.k: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.w: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.b: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.k: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.w: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.b: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.k: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
1 Corinthians 14:6, 9, 11, 12, 24, 28.w: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.b: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.k: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.w: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.b: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.k: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.w: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.b: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being”; the last Adam a life-giving spirit.
1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.k: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.w: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.b: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.
1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.k: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
1 Corinthians 15:21, 22, 45, 49.w: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

1 Corinthians 15:25, 26.b: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
1 Corinthians 15:25, 26.k: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
1 Corinthians 15:25, 26.w: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

1 Corinthians 15:25, 26.b: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
1 Corinthians 15:25, 26.k: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
1 Corinthians 15:25, 26.w: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

1 Corinthians 15:3, 4.b: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
1 Corinthians 15:3, 4.k: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
1 Corinthians 15:3, 4.w: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

1 Corinthians 15:3, 4.b: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
1 Corinthians 15:3, 4.k: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
1 Corinthians 15:3, 4.w: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

1 Corinthians 15:42, 43.b: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
1 Corinthians 15:42, 43.k: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
1 Corinthians 15:42, 43.w: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

1 Corinthians 15:42, 43.b: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
1 Corinthians 15:42, 43.k: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
1 Corinthians 15:42, 43.w: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

1 Corinthians 15:51, 52.b: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
1 Corinthians 15:51, 52.k: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
1 Corinthians 15:51, 52.w: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

1 Corinthians 15:51, 52.b: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
1 Corinthians 15:51, 52.k: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
1 Corinthians 15:51, 52.w: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

1 Corinthians 15:54-57.b: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
1 Corinthians 15:54-57.k: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
1 Corinthians 15:54-57.w: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

1 Corinthians 15:54-57.b: “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”
1 Corinthians 15:54-57.k: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
1 Corinthians 15:54-57.w: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

1 Corinthians 15:54-57.b: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
1 Corinthians 15:54-57.k: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
1 Corinthians 15:54-57.w: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

1 Corinthians 15:54-57.b: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!

1 John 2:19.b: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
1 John 2:19.k: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
1 John 2:19.w: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

1 John 2:20, 27.b: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
1 John 2:20, 27.k: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
1 John 2:20, 27.w: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

1 John 2:20, 27.b: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
1 John 2:20, 27.k: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
1 John 2:20, 27.w: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

1 John 2:24, 25.b: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
1 John 2:24, 25.k: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
1 John 2:24, 25.w: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

1 John 2:24, 25.b: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
1 John 2:24, 25.k: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
1 John 2:24, 25.w: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

1 John 2:3.b: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
1 John 2:3.k: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
1 John 2:3.w: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

1 John 2:3, 5.b: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
1 John 2:3, 5.k: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
1 John 2:3, 5.w: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

1 John 2:3, 5.b: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
1 John 2:3, 5.k: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
1 John 2:3, 5.w: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

1 John 3:1-3.b: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
1 John 3:1-3.k: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
1 John 3:1-3.w: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

1 John 3:1-3.b: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
1 John 3:1-3.k: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
1 John 3:1-3.w: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

1 John 3:1-3.b: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
1 John 3:1-3.k: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
1 John 3:1-3.w: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.b: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.k: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.w: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.b: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.k: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.w: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.b: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.k: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.w: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.b: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.k: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.w: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.b: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.k: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
1 John 3:14, 18, 19, 21, 24.w: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

1 John 3:17, 18.b: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
1 John 3:17, 18.k: But whoso hath this world’s good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
1 John 3:17, 18.w: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

1 John 3:17, 18.b: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
1 John 3:17, 18.k: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
1 John 3:17, 18.w: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

1 John 3:9.b: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
1 John 3:9.k: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
1 John 3:9.w: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

1 John 4:1.b: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
1 John 4:1.k: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
1 John 4:1.w: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

1 John 4:13.b: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
1 John 4:13.k: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
1 John 4:13.w: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

1 John 4:18.b: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
1 John 4:18.k: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
1 John 4:18.w: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

1 John 5:13.b: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
1 John 5:13.k: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
1 John 5:13.w: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

1 John 5:14.b: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
1 John 5:14.k: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
1 John 5:14.w: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

1 John 5:16.b: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
1 John 5:16.k: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
1 John 5:16.w: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

1 John 5:20.b: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
1 John 5:20.k: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
1 John 5:20.w: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

1 John 5:4, 5.b: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
1 John 5:4, 5.k: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
1 John 5:4, 5.w: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

1 John 5:4, 5.b: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
1 John 5:4, 5.k: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
1 John 5:4, 5.w: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

1 John 5:7.b: For there are three that testify:
1 John 5:7.k: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
1 John 5:7.w: For there are three who testify:

1 John 5:9.b: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
1 John 5:9.k: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
1 John 5:9.w: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

1 Kings 21:27, 29.b: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and fasted. He lay down in sackcloth and walked around meekly.
1 Kings 21:27, 29.k: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
1 Kings 21:27, 29.w: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

1 Kings 21:27, 29.b: “Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the calamity during his days, but I will bring it upon his house in the days of his son.”
1 Kings 21:27, 29.k: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.
1 Kings 21:27, 29.w: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”

1 Kings 8:27.b: But will God indeed dwell upon the earth? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
1 Kings 8:27.k: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
1 Kings 8:27.w: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

1 Peter 1:10, 11.b: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
1 Peter 1:10, 11.k: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
1 Peter 1:10, 11.w: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

1 Peter 1:10, 11.b: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
1 Peter 1:10, 11.k: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
1 Peter 1:10, 11.w: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

1 Peter 1:18, 19.b: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
1 Peter 1:18, 19.k: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
1 Peter 1:18, 19.w: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

1 Peter 1:18, 19.b: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
1 Peter 1:18, 19.k: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
1 Peter 1:18, 19.w: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

1 Peter 1:19, 20.b: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
1 Peter 1:19, 20.k: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
1 Peter 1:19, 20.w: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

1 Peter 1:19, 20.b: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.
1 Peter 1:19, 20.k: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
1 Peter 1:19, 20.w: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

1 Peter 1:2.b: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
1 Peter 1:2.k: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
1 Peter 1:2.w: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

1 Peter 1:5.b: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
1 Peter 1:5.k: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
1 Peter 1:5.w: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

1 Peter 2:11.b: Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.
1 Peter 2:11.k: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
1 Peter 2:11.w: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

1 Peter 2:15.b: For it is God’s will that by doing good you should silence the ignorance of foolish men.
1 Peter 2:15.k: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
1 Peter 2:15.w: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

1 Peter 2:17.b: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
1 Peter 2:17.k: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
1 Peter 2:17.w: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

1 Peter 2:2.b: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
1 Peter 2:2.k: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
1 Peter 2:2.w: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

1 Peter 2:5.b: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
1 Peter 2:5.k: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
1 Peter 2:5.w: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

1 Peter 2:7, 8.b: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
1 Peter 2:7, 8.k: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
1 Peter 2:7, 8.w: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

1 Peter 2:7, 8.b: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
1 Peter 2:7, 8.k: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
1 Peter 2:7, 8.w: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

1 Peter 3:18.b: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
1 Peter 3:18.k: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
1 Peter 3:18.w: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

1 Peter 3:19.b: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison
1 Peter 3:19.k: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
1 Peter 3:19.w: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

1 Peter 3:8-13.b: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
1 Peter 3:8-13.k: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
1 Peter 3:8-13.w: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

1 Peter 3:8-13.b: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
1 Peter 3:8-13.k: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
1 Peter 3:8-13.w: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

1 Peter 3:8-13.b: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
1 Peter 3:8-13.k: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
1 Peter 3:8-13.w: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

1 Peter 3:8-13.b: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
1 Peter 3:8-13.k: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
1 Peter 3:8-13.w: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

1 Peter 3:8-13.b: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
1 Peter 3:8-13.k: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
1 Peter 3:8-13.w: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

1 Peter 3:8-13.b: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
1 Peter 3:8-13.k: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
1 Peter 3:8-13.w: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

1 Peter 4:10, 11.b: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
1 Peter 4:10, 11.k: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
1 Peter 4:10, 11.w: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

1 Peter 4:10, 11.b: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
1 Peter 4:10, 11.k: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
1 Peter 4:10, 11.w: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

1 Peter 5:7.b: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
1 Peter 5:7.k: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
1 Peter 5:7.w: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

1 Thessalonians 1:10.b: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
1 Thessalonians 1:10.k: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
1 Thessalonians 1:10.w: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

1 Thessalonians 1:4, 5.b: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
1 Thessalonians 1:4, 5.k: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
1 Thessalonians 1:4, 5.w: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

1 Thessalonians 1:4, 5.b: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.
1 Thessalonians 1:4, 5.k: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
1 Thessalonians 1:4, 5.w: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

1 Thessalonians 4:17.b: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
1 Thessalonians 4:17.k: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
1 Thessalonians 4:17.w: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

1 Thessalonians 5:11, 14.b: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11, 14.k: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
1 Thessalonians 5:11, 14.w: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

1 Thessalonians 5:11, 14.b: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
1 Thessalonians 5:11, 14.k: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
1 Thessalonians 5:11, 14.w: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

1 Thessalonians 5:14.b: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
1 Thessalonians 5:14.k: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: and terror and dread will fall on them. By the power of Your arm they will be as still as a stone until Your people pass by, O LORD, until the people You have bought pass by.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O LORD, which thy hands have established.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, LORD, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: The LORD will reign forever and ever!”
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.b: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.k: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
Exodus 15:1-19, Psalms 107.w: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

James 2:8, 10-12.k: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
James 2:8, 10-12.w: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

James 2:8, 10-12.b: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
James 2:8, 10-12.k: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
James 2:8, 10-12.w: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

James 4:12.b: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
James 4:12.k: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
James 4:12.w: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

James 5:12.b: Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment.
James 5:12.k: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
James 5:12.w: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

Jeremiah 10:10.b: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.
Jeremiah 10:10.k: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
Jeremiah 10:10.w: But the LORD is the true God. He is the living God, and an everlasting King. At his wrath, the earth trembles. The nations aren’t able to withstand his indignation.

Jeremiah 10:7.b: Who would not fear You, O King of nations? This is Your due. For among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like You.
Jeremiah 10:7.k: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
Jeremiah 10:7.w: Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is no one like you.

Jeremiah 17:9.b: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
Jeremiah 17:9.k: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
Jeremiah 17:9.w: The heart is deceitful above all things and it is exceedingly corrupt. Who can know it?

Jeremiah 23:10.k: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
Jeremiah 23:10.w: “For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;

Jeremiah 23:23.b: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?”
Jeremiah 23:23.k: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
Jeremiah 23:23.w: “Am I a God at hand,” says the LORD, “and not a God afar off?

Jeremiah 32:40.b: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
Jeremiah 32:40.k: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
Jeremiah 32:40.w: I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

Jeremiah 4:2.b: and if you can swear, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then the nations will be blessed by Him, and in Him they will glory.”
Jeremiah 4:2.k: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
Jeremiah 4:2.w: and you will swear, ‘As the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”

Job 14:4.b: Who can bring out clean from unclean? No one!
Job 14:4.k: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
Job 14:4.w: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

Job 19:26, 27.b: Even after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God.
Job 19:26, 27.k: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
Job 19:26, 27.w: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

Job 19:26, 27.k: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
Job 19:26, 27.w: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

Job 21:14, 15.b: Yet they say to God: ‘Leave us alone! For we have no desire to know Your ways.
Job 21:14, 15.k: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
Job 21:14, 15.w: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

Job 21:14, 15.b: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve Him, and what would we gain if we pray to Him?’
Job 21:14, 15.k: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
Job 21:14, 15.w: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

Job 22:2, 3.b: “Can a man be of use to God? Can even a wise man benefit Him?
Job 22:2, 3.k: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
Job 22:2, 3.w: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

Job 22:2, 3.b: Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous? Does He profit if your ways are blameless?
Job 22:2, 3.k: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
Job 22:2, 3.w: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

Job 26:13.b: By His breath the skies were cleared; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
Job 26:13.k: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
Job 26:13.w: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

Job 35:7,8.b: If you are righteous, what do you give Him, or what does He receive from your hand?
Job 35:7,8.k: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?
Job 35:7,8.w: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

Job 35:7,8.b: Your wickedness affects only a man like yourself, and your righteousness only a son of man.
Job 35:7,8.k: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.
Job 35:7,8.w: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

Job 38:11.k: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

Job 8:13, 14.b: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.
Job 8:13, 14.k: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:

Job 9:2, 3.b: “Yes, I know that it is so, but how can a mortal be righteous before God?
Job 9:2, 3.k: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
Job 9:2, 3.w: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

Job 9:2, 3.k: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
Job 9:2, 3.w: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

Joel 2:12.b: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”
Joel 2:12.k: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

John 10:15, 16.b: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.

John 10:15, 16.w: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

John 10:16.b: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
John 10:16.k: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
John 10:16.w: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

John 10:18.b: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from My Father.”
John 10:18.k: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
John 10:18.w: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

John 10:26.b: But because you are not My sheep, you refuse to believe.
John 10:26.k: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
John 10:26.w: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

John 10:28.b: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
John 10:28.k: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
John 10:28.w: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

John 10:28, 29.b: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
John 10:28, 29.k: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
John 10:28, 29.w: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

John 10:28, 29.b: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
John 10:28, 29.k: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father’s hand.
John 10:28, 29.w: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

John 12:32.b: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”
John 12:32.k: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
John 12:32.w: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

John 13:18.b: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
John 13:18.k: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
John 13:18.w: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

John 14:11.b: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
John 14:11.k: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
John 14:11.w: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

John 14:13, 14.b: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
John 14:13, 14.k: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
John 14:13, 14.w: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

John 14:13, 14.b: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
John 14:13, 14.k: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
John 14:13, 14.w: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

John 14:14.b: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
John 14:14.k: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

John 14:19.w: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

John 14:6.w: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

John 15:4, 5.b: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
John 15:4, 5.k: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
John 15:4, 5.w: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

John 15:4, 5.b: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
John 15:4, 5.k: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
John 15:4, 5.w: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

John 16:13,14.k: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

John 17:2.b: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.

John 17:9.k: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
John 17:9.w: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

John 19:11.b: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”

John 19:11.w: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
