John 3:34.b: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
John 3:34.k: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
John 3:34.w: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

John 3:8.b: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
John 3:8.k: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
John 3:8.w: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

John 4:21.b: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
John 4:21.k: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
John 4:21.w: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

John 4:22.b: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
John 4:22.k: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
John 4:22.w: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

John 4:24.b: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
John 4:24.k: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
John 4:24.w: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

John 5:22, 27.b: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
John 5:22, 27.k: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
John 5:22, 27.w: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

John 5:22, 27.b: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
John 5:22, 27.k: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
John 5:22, 27.w: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

John 5:25.b: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
John 5:25.k: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
John 5:25.w: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

John 5:26.b: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
John 5:26.k: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
John 5:26.w: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

John 5:28, 29.b: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
John 5:28, 29.k: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
John 5:28, 29.w: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

John 5:28, 29.b: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
John 5:28, 29.k: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
John 5:28, 29.w: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

John 5:39.b: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
John 5:39.k: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
John 5:39.w: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

John 6:23.b: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
John 6:23.k: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
John 6:23.w: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

John 6:37.b: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
John 6:37.k: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
John 6:37.w: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

John 6:44.b: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
John 6:44.k: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
John 6:44.w: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

John 6:44, 45.b: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
John 6:44, 45.k: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
John 6:44, 45.w: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

John 6:44, 45.b: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
John 6:44, 45.k: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
John 6:44, 45.w: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

John 6:44, 45, 65.b: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
John 6:44, 45, 65.k: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
John 6:44, 45, 65.w: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

John 6:44, 45, 65.b: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
John 6:44, 45, 65.k: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
John 6:44, 45, 65.w: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

John 6:44, 45, 65.b: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
John 6:44, 45, 65.k: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
John 6:44, 45, 65.w: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

John 6:45.b: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
John 6:45.k: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
John 6:45.w: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

John 6:64.b: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
John 6:64.k: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
John 6:64.w: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

John 7:38, 39.b: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”
John 7:38, 39.k: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
John 7:38, 39.w: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

John 7:38, 39.b: He was speaking about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were later to receive. For the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
John 7:38, 39.k: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
John 7:38, 39.w: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

John 8:36.b: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
John 8:36.k: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
John 8:36.w: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

John 8:56.b: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”
John 8:56.k: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
John 8:56.w: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

Jude 4.b: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
Jude 4.k: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
Jude 4.w: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

Jude 6.b: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling—these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.
Jude 6.k: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
Jude 6.w: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

Jude 6, 7.b: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling—these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.
Jude 6, 7.k: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
Jude 6, 7.w: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

Jude 6, 7.b: In like manner, Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, who indulged in sexual immorality and pursued strange flesh, are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire.
Jude 6, 7.k: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
Jude 6, 7.w: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

Lamentations 3:26-31.b: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
Lamentations 3:26-31.k: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
Lamentations 3:26-31.w: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

Lamentations 3:26-31.b: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
Lamentations 3:26-31.k: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
Lamentations 3:26-31.w: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

Lamentations 3:26-31.b: Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it upon him.
Lamentations 3:26-31.k: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
Lamentations 3:26-31.w: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

Lamentations 3:26-31.b: Let him bury his face in the dust—perhaps there is still hope.
Lamentations 3:26-31.k: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
Lamentations 3:26-31.w: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

Lamentations 3:26-31.b: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
Lamentations 3:26-31.k: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
Lamentations 3:26-31.w: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

Lamentations 3:26-31.b: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
Lamentations 3:26-31.k: For the LORD will not cast off for ever:
Lamentations 3:26-31.w: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

Lamentations 3:31.b: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
Lamentations 3:31.k: For the LORD will not cast off for ever:
Lamentations 3:31.w: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

Leviticus 18.b: Then the LORD said to Moses,
Leviticus 18.k: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Leviticus 18.w: The LORD said to Moses,

Leviticus 18.b: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: I am the LORD your God.
Leviticus 18.k: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
Leviticus 18.w: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not follow the practices of the land of Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not follow the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you. You must not walk in their customs.
Leviticus 18.k: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
Leviticus 18.w: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

Leviticus 18.b: You are to practice My judgments and keep My statutes by walking in them. I am the LORD your God.
Leviticus 18.k: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
Leviticus 18.w: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.

Leviticus 18.b: Keep My statutes and My judgments, for the man who does these things will live by them. I am the LORD.
Leviticus 18.k: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.
Leviticus 18.w: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.

Leviticus 18.b: None of you are to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.
Leviticus 18.k: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not expose the nakedness of your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.
Leviticus 18.k: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; it would dishonor your father.
Leviticus 18.k: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.
Leviticus 18.k: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, for that would shame your family.
Leviticus 18.k: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, born to your father; she is your sister.
Leviticus 18.k: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
Leviticus 18.k: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.
Leviticus 18.k: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations with her; she is your aunt.
Leviticus 18.k: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; you are not to have sexual relations with her.
Leviticus 18.k: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife; that would shame your brother.
Leviticus 18.k: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. You are not to marry her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives; it is depraved.
Leviticus 18.k: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is still alive.
Leviticus 18.k: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not approach a woman to have sexual relations with her during her menstrual period.
Leviticus 18.k: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife and thus defile yourself with her.
Leviticus 18.k: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
Leviticus 18.k: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not lie with a man as with a woman; that is an abomination.
Leviticus 18.k: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.

Leviticus 18.b: You must not lie carnally with any animal, thus defiling yourself with it; a woman must not stand before an animal to mate with it; that is a perversion.
Leviticus 18.k: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

Leviticus 18.b: Do not defile yourselves by any of these practices, for by all these things the nations I am driving out before you have defiled themselves.
Leviticus 18.k: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
Leviticus 18.w: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

Leviticus 18.b: Even the land has become defiled, so I am punishing it for its sin, and the land will vomit out its inhabitants.
Leviticus 18.k: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
Leviticus 18.w: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

Leviticus 18.b: But you are to keep My statutes and ordinances, and you must not commit any of these abominations—neither your native-born nor the foreigner who lives among you.
Leviticus 18.k: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
Leviticus 18.w: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you

Leviticus 18.b: For the men who were in the land before you committed all these abominations, and the land has become defiled.
Leviticus 18.k: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
Leviticus 18.w: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),

Leviticus 18.b: So if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it spewed out the nations before you.
Leviticus 18.k: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
Leviticus 18.w: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

Leviticus 18.b: Therefore anyone who commits any of these abominations must be cut off from among his people.
Leviticus 18.k: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
Leviticus 18.w: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

Leviticus 18.b: You must keep My charge not to practice any of the abominable customs that were practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves by them. I am the LORD your God.”
Leviticus 18.k: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
Leviticus 18.w: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”

Leviticus 19:12.b: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
Leviticus 19:12.k: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
Leviticus 19:12.w: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

Luke 10:20.b: Nevertheless, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
Luke 10:20.k: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
Luke 10:20.w: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

Luke 12:35-40.b: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning.
Luke 12:35-40.k: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
Luke 12:35-40.w: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

Luke 12:35-40.b: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks, they can open the door for him at once.
Luke 12:35-40.k: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
Luke 12:35-40.w: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

Luke 12:35-40.b: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
Luke 12:35-40.k: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
Luke 12:35-40.w: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

Luke 12:35-40.b: Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.
Luke 12:35-40.k: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

Matthew 5:17-19.b: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
Matthew 5:17-19.k: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
Matthew 5:17-19.w: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

Matthew 5:17-19.b: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
Matthew 5:17-19.k: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
Matthew 5:17-19.w: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

Matthew 5:17-19.b: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
Matthew 5:17-19.k: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
Matthew 5:17-19.w: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

Matthew 5:34, 37.b: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
Matthew 5:34, 37.k: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:
Matthew 5:34, 37.w: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

Matthew 5:34, 37.b: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.
Matthew 5:34, 37.k: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
Matthew 5:34, 37.w: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

Matthew 6:11.b: Give us this day our daily bread.
Matthew 6:11.k: Give us this day our daily bread.
Matthew 6:11.w: Give us today our daily bread.

Matthew 6:12.b: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
Matthew 6:12.k: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
Matthew 6:12.w: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

Matthew 6:2, 5.b: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
Matthew 6:2, 5.k: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
Matthew 6:2, 5.w: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

Matthew 6:2, 5.b: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
Matthew 6:2, 5.k: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
Matthew 6:2, 5.w: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

Matthew 6:30.b: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
Matthew 6:30.k: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
Matthew 6:30.w: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

Matthew 6:6.b: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
Matthew 6:6.k: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
Matthew 6:6.w: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

Matthew 7:22, 23.b: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
Matthew 7:22, 23.k: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
Matthew 7:22, 23.w: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

Matthew 7:22, 23.b: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
Matthew 7:22, 23.k: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
Matthew 7:22, 23.w: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

Matthew 7:6.b: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.
Matthew 7:6.k: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

Micah 6:8.k: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

Nahum 1:2, 3.b: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
Nahum 1:2, 3.k: God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
Nahum 1:2, 3.w: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

Nahum 1:2, 3.k: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
Nahum 1:2, 3.w: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

Nehemiah 13:15-22.b: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, along with wine, grapes, and figs. All kinds of goods were being brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. So I warned them against selling food on that day.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.k: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.w: In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.

Nehemiah 13:15-22.b: Additionally, men of Tyre who lived there were importing fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them on the Sabbath to the people of Judah in Jerusalem.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.k: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.w: Some men of Tyre also lived there, who brought in fish and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

Nehemiah 13:15-22.b: Then I rebuked the nobles of Judah and asked, “What is this evil you are doing—profaning the Sabbath day?
Nehemiah 13:15-22.k: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
Nehemiah 13:15-22.w: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?

Nehemiah 13:15-22.b: Did not your forefathers do the same things, so that our God brought all this disaster on us and on this city? And now you are rekindling His wrath against Israel by profaning the Sabbath!”
Nehemiah 13:15-22.k: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.w: Didn’t your fathers do this, and didn’t our God bring all this evil on us and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”

Nehemiah 13:15-22.b: When the evening shadows began to fall on the gates of Jerusalem, just before the Sabbath, I ordered that the gates be shut and not opened until after the Sabbath. I posted some of my servants at the gates so that no load could enter on the Sabbath day.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.k: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.w: It came to pass that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, so that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.

Nehemiah 13:15-22.b: Once or twice, the merchants and those who sell all kinds of goods camped outside Jerusalem,
Nehemiah 13:15-22.k: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.w: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares camped outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

Nehemiah 13:15-22.b: but I warned them, “Why are you camping in front of the wall? If you do it again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they did not return on the Sabbath.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.k: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.w: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.

Nehemiah 13:15-22.b: Then I instructed the Levites to purify themselves and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this as well, O my God, and show me mercy according to Your abundant loving devotion.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.k: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.
Nehemiah 13:15-22.w: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.

Nehemiah 13:25.b: I rebuked them and called down curses on them. I beat some of these men and pulled out their hair. Then I made them take an oath before God and said, “You must not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters as wives for your sons or for yourselves!
Nehemiah 13:25.k: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.
Nehemiah 13:25.w: I contended with them, cursed them, struck certain of them, plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, “You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves.

Nehemiah 13:25-27.k: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

Nehemiah 13:25-27.b: Did not King Solomon of Israel sin in matters like this? There was not a king like him among many nations, and he was loved by his God, who made him king over all Israel—yet foreign women drew him into sin.
Nehemiah 13:25-27.k: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.
Nehemiah 13:25-27.w: Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.

Nehemiah 13:25-27.b: Must we now hear that you too are doing all this terrible evil and acting unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign women?”
Nehemiah 13:25-27.k: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
Nehemiah 13:25-27.w: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”

Nehemiah 9:32, 33.b: So now, our God, the great and mighty and awesome God who keeps His gracious covenant, do not view lightly all the hardship that has come upon us, and upon our kings and leaders, our priests and prophets, our ancestors and all Your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.
Nehemiah 9:32, 33.k: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
Nehemiah 9:32, 33.w: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, on our priests, on our prophets, on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

Nehemiah 9:32, 33.b: You are just in all that has befallen us, because You have acted faithfully, while we have acted wickedly.
Nehemiah 9:32, 33.k: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
Nehemiah 9:32, 33.w: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly.

Numbers 23:19.b: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?

Psalms 119:6.k: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
Psalms 119:6.w: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

Psalms 119:68.b: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
Psalms 119:68.k: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
Psalms 119:68.w: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

Psalms 119:72.b: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Psalms 119:72.k: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
Psalms 119:72.w: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

Psalms 122:6.b: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
Psalms 122:6.k: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
Psalms 122:6.w: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

Psalms 135:6.b: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
Psalms 135:6.k: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
Psalms 135:6.w: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

Psalms 143:2.b: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
Psalms 143:2.k: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
Psalms 143:2.w: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

Psalms 145:17.b: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
Psalms 145:17.k: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
Psalms 145:17.w: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

Psalms 147:20.b: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!
Psalms 147:20.k: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
Psalms 147:20.w: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

Psalms 148:13.b: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
Psalms 148:13.k: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
Psalms 148:13.w: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

Psalms 19:1-3.b: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
Psalms 19:1-3.k: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
Psalms 19:1-3.w: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

Psalms 19:1-3.b: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
Psalms 19:1-3.k: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
Psalms 19:1-3.w: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

Psalms 19:1-3.b: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
Psalms 19:1-3.k: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
Psalms 19:1-3.w: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

Psalms 19:7.b: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
Psalms 19:7.k: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
Psalms 19:7.w: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: The earth is the LORD’s, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.b: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts—He is the King of Glory. Selah
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.k: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
Psalms 24:4 ) (Ps. 24:4.w: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

Psalms 27:7-10.b: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
Psalms 27:7-10.k: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
Psalms 27:7-10.w: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

Psalms 27:7-10.b: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
Psalms 27:7-10.k: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
Psalms 27:7-10.w: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

Psalms 27:7-10.b: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
Psalms 27:7-10.k: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
Psalms 27:7-10.w: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

Psalms 27:7-10.b: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
Psalms 27:7-10.k: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
Psalms 27:7-10.w: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

Psalms 2:6.b: “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”
Psalms 2:6.k: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
Psalms 2:6.w: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

Psalms 30:7.b: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
Psalms 30:7.k: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
Psalms 30:7.w: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

Psalms 31:22.b: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
Psalms 31:22.k: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
Psalms 31:22.w: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

Psalms 32:3, 4.b: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
Psalms 32:3, 4.k: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
Psalms 32:3, 4.w: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

Psalms 32:3, 4.b: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
Psalms 32:3, 4.k: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
Psalms 32:3, 4.w: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

Psalms 32:5.b: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
Psalms 32:5.k: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
Psalms 32:5.w: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

Psalms 40:7, 8.b: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come—it is written about me in the scroll:
Psalms 40:7, 8.k: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
Psalms 40:7, 8.w: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

Psalms 40:7, 8.b: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
Psalms 40:7, 8.k: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
Psalms 40:7, 8.w: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

Psalms 42:5, 11.b: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
Psalms 42:5, 11.k: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
Psalms 42:5, 11.w: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

Psalms 42:5, 11.b: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
Psalms 42:5, 11.k: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
Psalms 42:5, 11.w: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

Psalms 45:7.b: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
Psalms 45:7.k: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
Psalms 45:7.w: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

Psalms 50:21.b: You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.
Psalms 50:21.k: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
Psalms 50:21.w: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

Psalms 51.b: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
Psalms 51.k: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
Psalms 51.w: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

Psalms 51.b: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
Psalms 51.k: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
Psalms 51.w: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

Psalms 51.b: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
Psalms 51.k: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
Psalms 51.w: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

Psalms 51.b: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
Psalms 51.k: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
Psalms 51.w: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

Psalms 51.b: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
Psalms 51.k: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
Psalms 51.w: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

Psalms 51.b: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
Psalms 51.k: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
Psalms 51.w: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

Psalms 51.b: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Psalms 51.k: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Psalms 51.w: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

Psalms 51.b: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
Psalms 51.k: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
Psalms 51.w: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

Psalms 51.b: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
Psalms 51.k: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
Psalms 51.w: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

Psalms 51.b: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
Psalms 51.k: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Psalms 51.w: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

Psalms 51.b: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.
Psalms 51.k: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
Psalms 51.w: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

Psalms 51.b: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
Psalms 51.k: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
Psalms 51.w: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

Psalms 51.b: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
Psalms 51.k: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
Psalms 51.w: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

Psalms 51.b: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
Psalms 51.k: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
Psalms 51.w: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

Psalms 51.b: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
Psalms 51.k: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
Psalms 51.w: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

Psalms 51.b: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
Psalms 51.k: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
Psalms 51.w: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

Psalms 51.b: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
Psalms 51.k: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
Psalms 51.w: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

Psalms 51.b: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
Psalms 51.k: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
Psalms 51.w: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

Psalms 51.b: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
Psalms 51.k: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
Psalms 51.w: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

Psalms 51:10, 12.b: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
Psalms 51:10, 12.k: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Psalms 51:10, 12.w: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

Psalms 51:10, 12.b: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
Psalms 51:10, 12.k: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
Psalms 51:10, 12.w: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

Psalms 51:5.b: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
Psalms 51:5.k: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
Psalms 51:5.w: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.b: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.k: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.w: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.b: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.k: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.w: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.b: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.k: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
Psalms 51:8, 12, 14.w: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

Psalms 55:17.b: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
Psalms 55:17.k: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
Psalms 55:17.w: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

Psalms 5:5, 6.b: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
Psalms 5:5, 6.k: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
Psalms 5:5, 6.w: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

Psalms 5:5, 6.b: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
Psalms 5:5, 6.k: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
Psalms 5:5, 6.w: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

Psalms 65:2.b: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
Psalms 65:2.k: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
Psalms 65:2.w: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

Psalms 72:17.b: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
Psalms 72:17.k: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
Psalms 72:17.w: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

Psalms 76:10.b: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
Psalms 76:10.k: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
Psalms 76:10.w: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

Psalms 76:11.b: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
Psalms 76:11.k: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
Psalms 76:11.w: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

Psalms 77:1-12.b: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
Psalms 77:1-12.k: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

Psalms 77:1-12.b: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
Psalms 77:1-12.k: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

Psalms 77:1-12.b: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
Psalms 77:1-12.k: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

Psalms 77:1-12.b: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
Psalms 77:1-12.k: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

Psalms 77:1-12.b: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
Psalms 77:1-12.k: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

Psalms 77:1-12.b: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
Psalms 77:1-12.k: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

Psalms 77:1-12.b: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
Psalms 77:1-12.k: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
Psalms 77:1-12.w: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

Psalms 77:1-12.b: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
Psalms 77:1-12.k: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
Psalms 77:1-12.w: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

Psalms 77:1-12.b: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
Psalms 77:1-12.k: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

Psalms 77:1-12.b: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
Psalms 77:1-12.k: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

Psalms 77:1-12.b: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
Psalms 77:1-12.k: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

Psalms 77:1-12.b: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
Psalms 77:1-12.k: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
Psalms 77:1-12.w: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

Psalms 77:7, 8.b: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
Psalms 77:7, 8.k: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
Psalms 77:7, 8.w: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

Psalms 77:7, 8.b: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
Psalms 77:7, 8.k: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
Psalms 77:7, 8.w: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

Psalms 81:11, 12.b: But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.
Psalms 81:11, 12.k: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
Psalms 81:11, 12.w: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

Psalms 81:11, 12.b: So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
Psalms 81:11, 12.k: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
Psalms 81:11, 12.w: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

Psalms 82:3, 4.b: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
Psalms 82:3, 4.k: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
Psalms 82:3, 4.w: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

Psalms 82:3, 4.b: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.
Psalms 82:3, 4.k: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
Psalms 82:3, 4.w: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

Psalms 88.b: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath Leannoth. A Maskil of Heman the Ezrahite. O LORD, the God of my salvation, day and night I cry out before You.
Psalms 88.k: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
Psalms 88.w: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

Psalms 88.b: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
Psalms 88.k: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
Psalms 88.w: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

Psalms 88.b: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
Psalms 88.k: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
Psalms 88.w: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

Psalms 88.b: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
Psalms 88.k: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
Psalms 88.w: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

Psalms 88.b: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
Psalms 88.k: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
Psalms 88.w: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

Psalms 88.b: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
Psalms 88.k: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
Psalms 88.w: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

Psalms 88.b: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
Psalms 88.k: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
Psalms 88.w: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

Psalms 88.b: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
Psalms 88.k: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
Psalms 88.w: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

Psalms 88.b: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
Psalms 88.k: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
Psalms 88.w: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

Psalms 88.b: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
Psalms 88.k: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
Psalms 88.w: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

Psalms 88.b: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
Psalms 88.k: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
Psalms 88.w: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

Psalms 88.b: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
Psalms 88.k: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
Psalms 88.w: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

Psalms 88.b: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
Psalms 88.k: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
Psalms 88.w: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

Psalms 88.b: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
Psalms 88.k: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
Psalms 88.w: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

Psalms 88.b: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
Psalms 88.k: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
Psalms 88.w: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

Psalms 88.b: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
Psalms 88.k: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
Psalms 88.w: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

Psalms 88.b: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
Psalms 88.k: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
Psalms 88.w: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

Psalms 88.b: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
Psalms 88.k: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
Psalms 88.w: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

Psalms 89:31, 32.b: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
