Psalms 89:31, 32.k: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
Psalms 89:31, 32.w: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

Psalms 89:31, 32.b: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
Psalms 89:31, 32.k: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
Psalms 89:31, 32.w: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

Psalms 89:31-33.b: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
Psalms 89:31-33.k: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
Psalms 89:31-33.w: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

Psalms 89:31-33.b: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
Psalms 89:31-33.k: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
Psalms 89:31-33.w: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

Psalms 89:31-33.b: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
Psalms 89:31-33.k: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
Psalms 89:31-33.w: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

Psalms 90:2.b: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
Psalms 90:2.k: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
Psalms 90:2.w: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

Psalms 95:1-7.b: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
Psalms 95:1-7.k: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
Psalms 95:1-7.w: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

Psalms 95:1-7.b: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
Psalms 95:1-7.k: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
Psalms 95:1-7.w: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

Psalms 95:1-7.b: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
Psalms 95:1-7.k: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
Psalms 95:1-7.w: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

Psalms 95:1-7.b: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
Psalms 95:1-7.k: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
Psalms 95:1-7.w: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

Psalms 95:1-7.b: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
Psalms 95:1-7.k: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
Psalms 95:1-7.w: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

Psalms 95:1-7.b: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
Psalms 95:1-7.k: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
Psalms 95:1-7.w: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

Psalms 95:1-7.b: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,
Psalms 95:1-7.k: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
Psalms 95:1-7.w: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

Revelation 12:17.b: And the dragon was enraged at the woman and went to make war with the rest of her children, who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus. And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea.
Revelation 12:17.k: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Revelation 12:17.w: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

Revelation 13:8.b: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.
Revelation 13:8.k: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
Revelation 13:8.w: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

Revelation 18:2.b: And he cried out in a mighty voice: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a lair for demons and a haunt for every unclean spirit, every unclean bird, and every detestable beast.
Revelation 18:2.k: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
Revelation 18:2.w: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

Revelation 19:10.b: So I fell at his feet to worship him. But he told me, “Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.”
Revelation 19:10.k: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
Revelation 19:10.w: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

Revelation 1:10.b: On the Lord’s day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,
Revelation 1:10.k: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
Revelation 1:10.w: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

Revelation 2.b: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
Revelation 2.k: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
Revelation 2.w: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:

Revelation 2.b: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
Revelation 2.k: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
Revelation 2.w: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

Revelation 2.b: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.
Revelation 2.k: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name’s sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
Revelation 2.w: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.

Revelation 2.b: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.
Revelation 2.k: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
Revelation 2.w: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

Revelation 2.b: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
Revelation 2.k: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
Revelation 2.w: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.

Revelation 2.b: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
Revelation 2.k: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
Revelation 2.w: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

Revelation 2.b: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
Revelation 2.k: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
Revelation 2.w: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

Revelation 2.b: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
Revelation 2.k: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
Revelation 2.w: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

Revelation 2.b: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
Revelation 2.k: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
Revelation 2.w: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

Revelation 2.b: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
Revelation 2.k: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
Revelation 2.w: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

Revelation 2.b: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
Revelation 2.k: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
Revelation 2.w: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

Revelation 2.b: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
Revelation 2.k: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
Revelation 2.w: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

Revelation 2.b: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits, yet you hold fast to My name. You did not deny your faith in Me, even in the days of My faithful witness Antipas, who was killed among you where Satan dwells.
Revelation 2.k: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan’s seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
Revelation 2.w: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

Revelation 2.b: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
Revelation 2.k: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
Revelation 2.w: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

Revelation 2.b: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
Revelation 2.k: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.
Revelation 2.w: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

Revelation 2.b: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
Revelation 2.k: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
Revelation 2.w: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

Revelation 2.b: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
Revelation 2.k: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
Revelation 2.w: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

Revelation 2.b: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
Revelation 2.k: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
Revelation 2.w: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

Revelation 2.b: I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance—and your latest deeds are greater than your first.
Revelation 2.k: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
Revelation 2.w: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

Revelation 2.b: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
Revelation 2.k: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
Revelation 2.w: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

Revelation 2.b: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
Revelation 2.k: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
Revelation 2.w: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

Revelation 2.b: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
Revelation 2.k: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
Revelation 2.w: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

Revelation 2.b: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
Revelation 2.k: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
Revelation 2.w: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

Revelation 2.b: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you
Revelation 2.k: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
Revelation 2.w: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

Revelation 2.b: than to hold fast to what you have until I come.
Revelation 2.k: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
Revelation 2.w: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

Revelation 2.b: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
Revelation 2.k: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
Revelation 2.w: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

Revelation 2.b: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery—just as I have received authority from My Father.
Revelation 2.k: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
Revelation 2.w: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;

Revelation 2.b: And I will give him the morning star.
Revelation 2.k: And I will give him the morning star.
Revelation 2.w: and I will give him the morning star.

Revelation 2.b: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
Revelation 2.k: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Revelation 2.w: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

Revelation 22:20.b: He who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
Revelation 22:20.k: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
Revelation 22:20.w: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!

Revelation 3.b: “To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of the One who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive, yet you are dead.
Revelation 3.k: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
Revelation 3.w: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

Revelation 3.b: Wake up and strengthen what remains, which is about to die; for I have found your deeds incomplete in the sight of My God.
Revelation 3.k: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
Revelation 3.w: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

Revelation 3.b: Remember, then, what you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know the hour when I will come upon you.
Revelation 3.k: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
Revelation 3.w: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

Revelation 3.b: But you do have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their garments, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white.
Revelation 3.k: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
Revelation 3.w: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

Revelation 3.b: Like them, he who overcomes will be dressed in white. And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name before My Father and His angels.
Revelation 3.k: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
Revelation 3.w: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

Revelation 3.b: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
Revelation 3.k: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Revelation 3.w: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

Revelation 3.b: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
Revelation 3.k: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
Revelation 3.w: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

Revelation 3.b: I know your deeds. Behold, I have placed before you an open door, which no one can shut. I know that you have only a little strength, yet you have kept My word and have not denied My name.
Revelation 3.k: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
Revelation 3.w: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

Revelation 3.b: As for those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead, I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.
Revelation 3.k: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
Revelation 3.w: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

Revelation 3.b: Because you have kept My command to persevere, I will also keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
Revelation 3.k: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
Revelation 3.w: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

Revelation 3.b: I am coming soon. Hold fast to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.
Revelation 3.k: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
Revelation 3.w: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

Revelation 3.b: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
Revelation 3.k: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
Revelation 3.w: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

Revelation 3.b: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
Revelation 3.k: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Revelation 3.w: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

Revelation 3.b: To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness, the Originator of God’s creation.
Revelation 3.k: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
Revelation 3.w: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:

Revelation 3.b: I know your deeds; you are neither cold nor hot. How I wish you were one or the other!
Revelation 3.k: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
Revelation 3.w: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

Revelation 3.b: So because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
Revelation 3.k: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
Revelation 3.w: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

Revelation 3.b: You say, ‘I am rich; I have grown wealthy and need nothing.’ But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
Revelation 3.k: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
Revelation 3.w: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

Revelation 3.b: I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
Revelation 3.k: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
Revelation 3.w: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

Revelation 3.b: Those I love I rebuke and discipline. Therefore be earnest and repent.
Revelation 3.k: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
Revelation 3.w: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

Revelation 3.b: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.
Revelation 3.k: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
Revelation 3.w: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

Revelation 3.b: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
Revelation 3.k: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
Revelation 3.w: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

Revelation 3.b: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.”
Revelation 3.k: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Revelation 3.w: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

Revelation 3:12.b: The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
Revelation 3:12.k: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
Revelation 3:12.w: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

Revelation 5:12-14.b: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
Revelation 5:12-14.k: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
Revelation 5:12-14.w: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

Revelation 5:12-14.b: And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!”
Revelation 5:12-14.k: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
Revelation 5:12-14.w: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

Revelation 5:12-14.b: And the four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.
Revelation 5:12-14.k: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
Revelation 5:12-14.w: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

Romans 10:14, 17.b: How then can they call on the One in whom they have not believed? And how can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone to preach?
Romans 10:14, 17.k: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
Romans 10:14, 17.w: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

Romans 10:14, 17.b: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
Romans 10:14, 17.k: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
Romans 10:14, 17.w: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

Romans 10:14,15,17.b: How then can they call on the One in whom they have not believed? And how can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone to preach?
Romans 10:14,15,17.k: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
Romans 10:14,15,17.w: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

Romans 10:14,15,17.b: And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”
Romans 10:14,15,17.k: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
Romans 10:14,15,17.w: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”

Romans 10:14,15,17.b: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
Romans 10:14,15,17.k: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
Romans 10:14,15,17.w: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

Romans 10:4.b: For Christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes.
Romans 10:4.k: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
Romans 10:4.w: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

Romans 10:5.b: For concerning the righteousness that is by the law, Moses writes: “The man who does these things will live by them.”
Romans 10:5.k: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
Romans 10:5.w: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

Romans 11:32-34.b: For God has consigned everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on everyone.
Romans 11:32-34.k: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
Romans 11:32-34.w: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

Romans 11:32-34.b: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
Romans 11:32-34.k: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
Romans 11:32-34.w: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

Romans 11:32-34.b: “Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”
Romans 11:32-34.k: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
Romans 11:32-34.w: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

Romans 11:33.b: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
Romans 11:33.k: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
Romans 11:33.w: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

Romans 11:34-36.b: “Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”
Romans 11:34-36.k: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
Romans 11:34-36.w: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

Romans 11:34-36.b: “Who has first given to God, that God should repay him?”
Romans 11:34-36.k: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
Romans 11:34-36.w: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

Romans 11:34-36.b: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever! Amen.
Romans 11:34-36.k: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
Romans 11:34-36.w: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

Romans 11:36.b: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever! Amen.
Romans 11:36.k: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
Romans 11:36.w: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

Romans 11:5, 6, 20.b: In the same way, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.
Romans 11:5, 6, 20.k: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
Romans 11:5, 6, 20.w: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

Romans 11:5, 6, 20.b: And if it is by grace, then it is no longer by works. Otherwise, grace would no longer be grace.
Romans 11:5, 6, 20.k: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
Romans 11:5, 6, 20.w: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

Romans 11:5, 6, 20.b: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.
Romans 11:5, 6, 20.k: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
Romans 11:5, 6, 20.w: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

Romans 11:7.b: What then? What Israel was seeking, it failed to obtain, but the elect did. The others were hardened,
Romans 11:7.k: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
Romans 11:7.w: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

Romans 11:7, 8.b: What then? What Israel was seeking, it failed to obtain, but the elect did. The others were hardened,
Romans 11:7, 8.k: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
Romans 11:7, 8.w: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

Romans 11:7, 8.b: as it is written: “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see, and ears that could not hear, to this very day.”
Romans 11:7, 8.k: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
Romans 11:7, 8.w: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

Romans 13:1-4.b: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
Romans 13:1-4.k: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
Romans 13:1-4.w: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

Romans 13:1-4.b: Consequently, whoever resists authority is opposing what God has set in place, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.
Romans 13:1-4.k: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
Romans 13:1-4.w: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

Romans 13:1-4.b: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you want to be unafraid of the one in authority? Then do what is right, and you will have his approval.
Romans 13:1-4.k: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
Romans 13:1-4.w: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

Romans 13:1-4.b: For he is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not carry the sword in vain. He is God’s servant, an agent of retribution to the wrongdoer.
Romans 13:1-4.k: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
Romans 13:1-4.w: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

Romans 13:5-7.b: Therefore it is necessary to submit to authority, not only to avoid punishment, but also as a matter of conscience.
Romans 13:5-7.k: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
Romans 13:5-7.w: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

Romans 13:5-7.b: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.
Romans 13:5-7.k: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
Romans 13:5-7.w: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

Romans 13:5-7.b: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
Romans 13:5-7.k: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
Romans 13:5-7.w: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

Romans 13:8-10.b: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
Romans 13:8-10.k: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
Romans 13:8-10.w: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

Romans 13:8-10.b: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
Romans 13:8-10.k: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
Romans 13:8-10.w: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

Romans 13:8-10.b: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
Romans 13:8-10.k: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
Romans 13:8-10.w: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

Romans 14:10, 12.b: Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
Romans 14:10, 12.k: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
Romans 14:10, 12.w: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

Romans 14:10, 12.b: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.
Romans 14:10, 12.k: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
Romans 14:10, 12.w: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

Romans 14:17.b: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
Romans 14:17.k: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

Romans 8:32.w: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

Romans 8:34.b: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.
Romans 8:34.k: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
Romans 8:34.w: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

Romans 8:9, 14.w: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

Zechariah 12:10.b: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer, and they will look on Me, the One they have pierced. They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son.
Zechariah 12:10.k: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
Zechariah 12:10.w: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.
